arStrings.szText: I told her to stay away. I told her, but she wouldn’t listen. She thought she could reach me again. But she couldn’t. Not this time.
You… you can end it. You can end it and take the stone. You can get it to the tomb, I know you can.
Neyrelle... we don’t know that. Killing you might just free Mephisto. We need to see this through. And we will. Together.

And I know how much you're suffering...believe me, I do. But killing you might just free Mephisto. We have to finish this together.
In Neyrelle, the warlock sees a lifetime of struggling with demons. Wants to believe in hope.
Maka believed in you. So do I. And I’ve survived far worse than that stone.
(shaky breath) Then let’s get to that tomb, and finish this for good.
